searchText: If we want option #1 it also means initcode validation consumes all provided gas. I updated the proposed clarification. Does not look very bad. https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/6328 There is also one more check: the CREATE instruction coming from EOF must have EOF initcode. I thought we were removing CREATE from inside EOF for v1? Until a fuller solution could be examined? Yes, we just called it internally as "EOF v1.1" to not disturb testing efforts. We should discuss all this on the Wednesday call
